$comment: Maps SCF database framework_id values to CheckID framework keys. Source: SecFrame/SCF/scf.db frameworks table (SCF 2026.1).

iso-27001.$comment: 28=ISO 27001 (requirements clauses), 29=ISO 27002 (Annex A controls). Old registry used Annex A notation (A.5.15 = 27002 5.15). Union both for full coverage.

hipaa.$comment: 124=Administrative Simplification 2013, 125=Security Rule / NIST SP 800-66 R2. HICP entries removed in SCF 2026.1.

fedramp.$comment: 114=low, 115=moderate, 116=high, 117=LI-SaaS. Split from single ID 118 in SCF 2025.4.

iso-27017.$comment: ISO/IEC 27017:2015 — cloud-specific security controls, extends ISO 27001/27002.

nist-800-171.$comment: NIST SP 800-171 R2 — protecting CUI in non-federal systems. DoD contractor requirement.

nis2.$comment: EU NIS2 Directive (2022/2555) — network and information security measures for essential/important entities.

manualOnly.$comment: Frameworks NOT in the SCF database. Must be carried from scf-check-mapping.json manually.
